messages:
Samir Patel: urgent - support flagged that multiple internal analytics users could list s3://redwood-internal-models. possible exposure of model artifacts. @Priya @Luis please triage.

Priya Kapoor: on it. noticed role-mapper ran a batch at ~02:03. i'm pulling the migration logs now. marking P0 until we confirm scope.

deploy-bot: migration rbac-refactor-v9 applied by ci/cd at 2026-02-27T02:03:18Z (id: mig-20260227-9)

Luis Gomez: quick hypothesis: role-mapper templating bug turned a scoped principal into a wildcard. If so, bucket policy may still have KMS deny but S3 List/Get could be allowed. Checking policy diffs.

Priya Kapoor: found the template diff. old: `principal: team:analytics` new: `principal: ${role_principal}` but role_principal resolved to `*` because of an unset env var in the mapper. snippet: 
```
- Effect: Allow
  Principal: { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/team-analytics" }
+ Effect: Allow
  Principal: { "AWS": "*" }
  Action: ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"]
```
This was applied to the internal-models bucket binding.

Samir Patel: ouch. mitigation plan: 1) stop role-mapper job 2) add explicit Deny to bucket policy for outside principals 3) rotate SA used by mapper and revoke sessions 4) audit list of objects accessed in last 24h. assign owners?

Priya Kapoor: i'll stop the mapper and push deny to bucket policy now. patch i'm going to apply: 
```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-internal-models --policy '"Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Principal": {"AWS":"*"},"Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-internal-models/*","Condition":{"StringNotEquals":{"aws:PrincipalArn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/team-analytics"}}}]'
```
This will block any principal except the intended role. applying in 1m.

sec_ops_bot: incident INC-20260227-014 created (sev=P0) assigned to eng-security, sec-ops, and compliance.

Luis Gomez: running quick checks with `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` against the mapper's role and an example analytics user. also checking CloudTrail for ListObjects calls. early sign: there were 18 ListBucket calls from 02:04-02:11 by role arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/role-mapper/instance. No GetObject decrypts recorded in KMS logs.

Alice Cheng: i'll pull audit logs and prepare a data-access timeline. tagging legal & compliance for notification. can you add the CloudTrail query you used?

Luis Gomez: CloudTrail query (CloudWatch Logs Insights): 
```sql
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.bucketName
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com" and requestParameters.bucketName = "redwood-internal-models"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```
gave me the 18 ListBucket events. Objects not downloaded (no GetObject/No KMS Decrypt).

Priya Kapoor: deny applied. please verify access from an external test principal.

Luis Gomez: verified from an external test IAM user: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-internal-models` now returns AccessDenied. internal analytics role still has access. good.

Samir Patel: good containment. next actions: - rotate mapper SA keys + revoke tokens (Priya) - revert the bad migration and redeploy a fixed mapper (deploy team) - run backfill audit for 48h and produce list of objects that were visible (Alice + Luis) - notify affected customers + compliance (Alice) - add unit/integration tests to catch empty template variables and wildcard principals (Engineering)

Priya Kapoor: started SA rotation and revoked current session tokens for the mapper:
```bash
aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id AKIA... --status Inactive --user-name role-mapper-sa
aws sts revoke-session --session-id ... (internal tooling)
```
also opened PR to add validation in mapper: require non-empty `role_principal` and reject `*`.

deploy-bot: rolled back migration mig-20260227-9 at 2026-02-27T02:22:10Z (initiated by Priya Kapoor).

Luis Gomez: KMS CloudTrail check: no Decrypt API calls against key alias/redwood-models-key during window. good — no key compromise. I'll still schedule a key rotation for the key in 48h as precaution.

Alice Cheng: drafting customer notification and compliance timeline. preliminary note: no object downloads detected, containment in <20m, root cause = role-mapper template var resolution bug. will share draft for review in #inc-communications.

Samir Patel: followups for engineering: add lint/CI that fails if principal resolves to `*`, and add an e2e test that simulates missing env var. Luis, can you own the test?

Luis Gomez: yes. i'll add an integration test to the mapper repo and a policy-lint job in CI.

Priya Kapoor: opened change request to also add a cross-check in deploy pipeline that runs `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` after applying role changes. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/role-mapper/pull/412

Alice Cheng: compliance asked for exported audit CSV. i'll add CloudTrail query + S3 access list, will share in the incident ticket.

Samir Patel: closing loop: SecOps will keep the incident open until legal signs off and the mapper has the tests/CI in place. great quick response — nice work team :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: thanks everyone. will follow up with postmortem draft later today.

Luis Gomez: +1. postmortem items: - root cause: unset env var -> wildcard principal - detection: customer report -> logs - containment: bucket deny + rollback - remediation: SA rotation, CI tests, post-deploy simulation - follow-ups: KMS rotation, audit backfill.

Alice Cheng: added action item: notify customers with timeline and FAQ. will ping when draft ready.

Samir Patel: agreed. flagging for postmortem and lessons learned.

Priya Kapoor: ping me if you need audit queries or access.

Alice Cheng: draft sent to legal/compliance for review.

Samir Patel: thanks all — incident remains open until compliance sign-off. :lock:
